title: ScavengeItem
description: This plugin is a Scavenge Hunt plugin, that's library is easily customizable, the controls are easy, and the fun is max!
body:
# 🔍 ScavengeItem
**The ultimate "Race-to-Find" challenge for your Minecraft server!**

Turn your server into a high-stakes scavenger hunt with **ScavengeItem**. No more boring fetch quests—this plugin creates a fast-paced, server-wide competition where players must use their knowledge of the world to find a specific item before anyone else.

### 🎮 How It Works
When an admin triggers a hunt, a specific item is broadcasted directly to every player’s **Title Screen**. The clock starts immediately! Players must craft, loot, or trade to get that exact item into their inventory. The first person to find it wins the round and claims the glory (and the rewards).

### ⚡ Key Features
**Immersive Alerts:** Uses the Minecraft **Title and Subtitle** system to announce items, ensuring no player misses the start of the hunt.
**Admin-Driven Events:** Complete control via the `/sitem start` command. Start a challenge whenever the server energy needs a boost.
**Real-Time Competition:** Create "First-to-Find" scenarios that encourage exploration and quick thinking.
**Lightweight & Fast:** Designed to run in the background without causing lag, even during peak player counts.

### 🛠️ Commands
`/sitem start` – Initiates a new scavenger hunt for a random item.
`/sitem stop` – Ends the current hunt manually.

### 🏆 Perfect For:
**Community Events:** Keep your players engaged during "happy hour" or scheduled event nights.
**Survival & Skyblock:** Add an extra layer of challenge to the grind.
**Streamers:** A great way to interact with your viewers by letting them compete for prizes in real-time.

**Who has the fastest hands on the server? Find out with ScavengeItem!**
